about: Footprints and symbols checked against reference libraries (Espressif's, KiCad's), which are CC-BY-SA and so downloaded (scripts/corpus.sh, into the corpus folder's cad/), never committed. A footprint comes from a corpus datasheet the way the app builds it, or from a drawing an agent recorded (drawn); pad centres agree within tolerance mm (sizes too when sizes is set). A symbol's pins come from the datasheet's pin table; numbers agree, names when they share a part (aliases for the rest; missing lists the reference's pins the datasheet doesn't have).

footprints.name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1

footprints.name: TPS63900 WSON (DSK0010A)
footprints.why: TI's drawing read into its outline and land pattern. KiCad has no DSK0010A of TI's: its generic WSON-10 is its own IPC calculation (0.825 mm pads, rows 2.425 mm apart) where TI's land pattern has 0.6 mm pads 2.3 mm apart, so pad centres only, to 0.07 mm.

footprints.name: TPS2595 WSON (DSG0008A)
footprints.why: The eFuses' WSON, against KiCad's own copy of TI's DSG0008A: pads exactly in place. TI's land pattern (p47) has 0.5 mm pads where KiCad's copy has 0.6 mm; the pin table calls the exposed pad PAD, KiCad 9.

footprints.name: PCM5102A TSSOP (PW0020A)
footprints.why: A gull-wing from TI's drawing, its land pattern TI's (1.5 × 0.45 mm pads, rows 5.8 mm apart).

footprints.name: NDS331N SOT-23 (named, not drawn)
footprints.why: A datasheet with no package drawing: 'Industry standard outline SOT-23' on its first page names the package, and the standard outline stands in. Same tolerances as the standard SOT-23 entry.
